---
title: The useful art of returning
description: Why a second reading is often where the interesting work begins.
date: 2026-10-15
categories: [Reading]
---

A passage changes when we return to it. The words are the same, but the
questions we bring have become more precise. A note left in the margin is
a small invitation to our future self.

## Keep a question

Instead of recording everything, keep the question that made you pause.
It gives the next reading a place to begin.
